svg.title: C26 / LISA PENDULUM PATHFINDER engineering mission profile
svg.desc: C26, LISA PENDULUM PATHFINDER. Original project: Low Frequency Prototype of Laser Interferometer Suspensions for Gravitational Wave Detection. Session C: Astronomy & Space Physics. Scientific question: Which suspension geometry and damping strategy improve displacement isolation over a declared frequency band without excessive thermal noise, cross-axis coupling, or control instability? Testable hypothesis: A measured multi-stage model with independently constrained loss and coupling will predict bench performance better than ideal pendulum scaling, and identify the actual low-frequency noise floor.. Project empirical evidence pending. No project observations acquired. All verification-case counts are specified planned work, not completed experiments. Decorative orbital motifs encode no measured values. No NASA affiliation or approval claimed.
svg.text: Low Frequency Prototype of Laser Interferometer Suspensions for Gravitational Wave Detection
No project observations acquired · specified cases await execution · shared demonstrations are separately labeled
Build a terrestrial suspension and displacement-readout prototype inspired
by precision interferometry; the name is thematic and does not imply this is
LISA flight hardware. Measure isolation, resonances, damping, and
thermal/noise limits at low frequencies. Treat low resonance as one design
property, not an automatic guarantee of reduced thermal motion or
Which suspension geometry and damping strategy improve displacement
isolation over a declared frequency band without excessive thermal noise,
TESTABLE HYPOTHESIS / NOT AN OBSERVED RESULT
A measured multi-stage model with independently constrained loss and
coupling will predict bench performance better than ideal pendulum scaling,
and identify the actual low-frequency noise floor.
The fluctuation-dissipation expression uses a passive, equilibrium response
Active damping, readout noise, tilt-horizontal coupling, and structural loss
VALIDITY LIMITS / THE CLAIM STOPS HERE
A room-scale prototype cannot claim astrophysical detector sensitivity.
Spring-antispring reduction of resonance does not necessarily reduce thermal
noise; suspension geometry and dissipative elements matter.
COUNTS OF RECORDS · NO COMPLETION SCORES
TRACEABILITY / IDs THAT STAY WITH THE WORK
Execution evidence is required before case closure.
References are pointers; archive acquisition is separate.
A question becomes a model. A model earns evidence.
NASA-inspired mission names are creative identifiers. This profile describes research design; it claims no NASA approval or flight qualification.
Original titles are preserved. Data pointers and citations do not establish that the original teams’ observations have been acquired.
